Features

  • Alert

    +5 to initiative and cannot be surprised.

  • Assassinate: Initiative

    You are deadliest against unprepared enemies. In combat, you have  Advantage on Attack Rolls against creatures that haven't taken a turn yet.

  • Dolor Amarus

    When you land a Critical Hit with a weapon or unarmed attack,[See: Bugs] it deals an additional 7 damage.

  • Dwarven Resilience

    Advantage on saving throws against being poisoned and resistance to poison damage.

  • Evasion

    Successful DEX saves nullify damage; failed DEX saves reduce it by half.

  • Morphic Ambush

    Any successful Attack Roll against a creature that has been Ambushed by a Doppelganger is a Critical Hit.

  • Nimble Alchemist

    A potions master, Dolor can throw or drink potions as a free action.

  • Opportunity Attack

    Attack an enemy moving out of reach.

  • Reliable Talent

    When you make an Ability Check with a Skill you are Proficient with, the lowest result you can roll on the die is 10.

  • Resilient: Wisdom

    • You increase your Wisdom by 1, to a maximum of 20.
    • Gain Proficiency in Wisdom Saving Throws.

  • Stealthy

    +1 to Stealth.

  • Uncanny Dodge

    Can use a reaction to reduce the damage of an incoming hit by half.

Dwarf_Commoner
Dolor[1] is a serial killer seeking to gain the Bhaalist title of Unholy Assassin by impressing the Murder Tribunal. He is the son of  Ffion Goldgrind, who was a sex worker at Sharess' Caress before being murdered by Dolor. He is first encountered under the false name Master Meztli.
“
It was perfect... perfectperfectperfect... You have sullied it with knowledge. Made it an unclean sacrifice. I will remember your face.
„
— Dolor, if revealed during the Wine Festival

Involvement

While most of Dolor's confirmed murders were committed in order to ⁠Impress the Murder Tribunal, the murder of his mother - according to Ffion herself (via  Speak with Dead) - was committed because she discovered his 'secret'. According to Ffion, Dolor enjoys murder, specifically killing people slowly.

Despite the fact that he was only required to murder two targets in order to become an Unholy Assassin, Dolor continued and so far has successfully murdered four victims;  Father Lorgan,  Franc Peartree,  Alexander Rainforest and  Duke Stelmane. This string of successes has earned the attention[2] as well as admiration[3] of Bhaalist  Doppelgangers who are witnesses to his murders and assist him if need be.[4]

His murders are currently being investigated by two Flaming Fist officers,  Valeria and  Devella Fountainhead. Investigator Valeria is in Sharess' Caress having drinks as she has concluded that a refugee named  Brilgor is responsible for Father Lorgar's murder. However her assistant is much closer in finding the truth; Constable Fountainhead can be found in Elfsong Tavern investigating for clues in the room of Duke Stelmane, Dolor's latest murder victim.

Dolor can be encountered in the Lower City, on different occasions, first at the Wine Festival where he can be found posing as a wine connoisseur (under the alias Master Meztli) in order to poison  Cora Highberry. This only happens if the party have read any of the  Bloodstained Parchments before, which can be found in several locations. The party can expose him here, triggering a battle with several doppelgangers, during which he attempts to flee using  Dimension Door.[5] If it is Counterspelled, he attempts to escape via  invisibility.

If Dolor is able to flee from the Wine Festival, his next mark is  Figaro Pennygood, owner of Facemaker's Boutique. The party can disturb him mid-assassination and kill him in the ensuing battle. A paralyzed Devella Fountainhead is also there and is the first target of Dolor during combat. If Dolor is killed his looted corpse contains the  Dirge of the Unholy Assassin, which reveals the location of the Bhaalist Murder Tribunal and the password Sicarius, as well as the  Hand Bag with the severed hands required for entry.

If the player character independently seeks the Murder Tribunal by becoming an Unholy Assassin and certain conditions are met, Dolor must be fought at the Tribunal as a professional rival. Alternatively, Dolor can be convinced with a  DC 25 Persuasion Check to turn on the Tribunal, arguing it does not properly serve  Bhaal since it is pitting two perfect killers against each other. If Dolor is convinced, he states that Bhaal is not a god of decrees and doctrines and attacks the Guardians. If he survives the encounter he proceeds to attack  Sarevok Anchev as well as  Echo of Amelyssan,  Echo of Sendai, and  Echo of Illasera. However he is instantly killed as Sarevok uses  Power Word Kill on the dwarf. If the Murder Tribunal is defeated and Dolor survives, he turns on the party and immediately attacks them.

If the player character encounters Dolor at the wine festival, steals both the Dirge of the Unholy Assassin and the Hand Bag, and leaves without combat, then Dolor can be found wandering outside the Murder Tribunal complaining that he is not allowed entry.

Combat

Dolor is explicitly coded to have two  Bonus Actions, one of which he spends using a grenade (typically Karabasan's Gift) as a special variant of  Throw that uses bonus actions.

Because of Dolor's high Dexterity and access to the  Alert feat, it can be difficult to start before him in combat. Furthermore, failing the appropriate checks can leave the party surprised, allowing Dolor to escape to this next target on unprepared parties.  Elixir of Vigilance and party members with the Alert feat are useful when encountering him.

Speak with Dead

Dolor can be spoken to with  Speak with Dead.

  • Who are you?
    • Meztli
      Dolor... A humble servant... A most glorious aspirant...
  • Why did you kill all those people?
    • Meztli
      My becoming... Unholy... Assassin...
      • What's an Unholy Assassin?
        • Meztli
          Avatar... of... Murder...
      • How does one become an Unholy Assassin?
        • Meztli
          Prove thyself... Before the Tribunal
      • How do I get access to the Murder Tribunal?
        • Meztli
          Speak the word at the door... Bring proof of two sacrifices...
          • What word must be spoken?
            • Meztli
              Sicarius...
          • What proof will the Tribunal require?
            • Meztli
              An innocent's hand... To touch divinity...
  • Why were these targets chosen?
    • Narrator
      *The corpse remains silent. It does not know.*
      • What is the Murder Tribunal?
        • Meztli
          The Tribunal... It...
          • Narrator
            *The corpse tries to speak but something prevents it.*

Notes and references

  2. ↑  A Promising Candidate
  3. ↑  A Murderous Masterpiece
  4. ↑ For example, during  Cora's attempted murder they do not intervene if Cora simply drinks the wine and Dolor murders her before teleporting away, however if the player character intervenes they assist the dwarf during his escape attempt.
  5. ↑ While Dolor carries the  Spaceshunt Boots, the Act3b_LOW_SerialKiller_HighberrysHouse  script contains a trigger for him to cast  Boots of Dimension Door, a 5th level version of Dimension Door with a range of 100 m (333 ft) as opposed to the usual 50 m (167 ft), exclusively at the wine festival.

Bugs

  • If Dolor is killed at the wine festival, picking up his corpse and holding onto it (in a character's inventory, or by placing it in any container) may cause the game save to corrupt after the next long rest. Reverting to a save prior to a long rest and dropping the corpse (near the wine festival, if possible) can resolve the issue.[verify]
